anonymization.accounts: Display labels use work-account/personal-account; identifier keys use work_account/personal_account.
anonymization.paths: Evidence paths are relative to the repository root; .. retains locations outside it. Historical commands anchor external paths at ${PWD}. Evidence was not copied or moved.
anonymization.history: Original timestamps, hashes, results and caveats are retained. Labels and paths are anonymized representations; historical verification does not attest to edited bytes or current live state.

scope: Codex fresh-login home isolation in the terminal app; not startup UI or model routing.

diagnosis.confirmed_defect: Fresh login selected an unused display name but recursive directory creation accepted an occupied credential home, including after an account rename.
diagnosis.existing_credentials_provenance: Unresolved: this defect does not establish how two currently distinct homes obtained the same real login. Refresh timestamps do not prove a new browser login.
diagnosis.duplicate_gauge_suppression: Unchanged. It does not resolve the intended-login mismatch.

changes.change: Reserve an unoccupied home using exclusive mkdir at 0700; skip registered names/paths and occupied files, directories, symlinks; propagate other I/O errors.
Replace free-name plus recursive creation with the reservation helper.
Own per-test synthetic homes and exercise renamed registered homes both present and absent.
Drive actual executable n -> l -> Enter and prove existing credential homes are not reused or overwritten.
Record that duplicate display handling is not authentication restoration; require atomic fresh-home allocation and explicit recovery boundaries.

simplifications: One reservation operation replaces separate name selection and permissive recursive slot creation.
No new dependencies, quota heuristics, credential copying, or display-only workaround.

before_fix_installed_pty_regression.assertion: a new login must never reuse an existing credential home

workspace.command: env -u MINDPLAYER_VERSION -u MINDPLAYER_TEST_BINARY -u MINDPLAYER_TEST_REAL_JEV CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test --offline --locked --workspace -q -- --test-threads=2

checks.release_build: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo build --offline --locked --release -p mindplayer-tui --bin mindplayer: passed

installed_pty.command: env -u MINDPLAYER_VERSION -u MINDPLAYER_TEST_REAL_JEV CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 MINDPLAYER_TEST_BINARY=${PWD}/../../../../../../.local/bin/mindplayer cargo test --offline --locked -p mindplayer-tui --test smoke -q -- --test-threads=2
installed_pty.authentication: Synthetic provider fixtures only; not proof of restored real work-account credentials.

remaining: Real work-account and personal-account credentials still identify the same login; separate usage is not restored.
User must select recovery scope: MindPlayer-only isolated work-account home versus changing the inherited default Codex login; browser authentication is required.
No intended work-account credential was recovered from the inspected bounded auth/backup locations. Do not synthesize identity from labels or copy existing personal-account credentials.
Existing running MindPlayer instances keep their original executable until relaunched.
